faqItems.question: When should my child's first dental visit happen?
faqItems.answer: The initial visit focuses on getting to know your little one, a gentle informative exam, and empowering your family with resources for smiling success. We invite your child to bring their favorite toy for comfort.

faqItems.question: How do you handle anxious or scared kids?
faqItems.answer: Our team, along with our therapy dog Bailey, creates a fun, welcoming, and stress-free environment. We use gentle techniques and a compassionate approach to make every visit positive.

faqItems.question: Do you offer laughing gas or sedation for children?
faqItems.answer: The website does not explicitly state that laughing gas or sedation for children is offered. Please contact the office directly for more information on available options.

faqItems.question: What if my child knocks out a baby tooth?
faqItems.answer: While the website doesn't specify action for a knocked-out baby tooth, for any dental emergency, it's best to contact Tiki Dental immediately for guidance and to schedule an urgent appointment.

faqItems.question: Do you accept pediatric dental insurance?
faqItems.answer: Tiki Dental accepts various insurance plans. You can email Insurance@TikiDental.com to inquire about specific insurance information and coverage for pediatric dental services.

faqItems.question: Are dental sealants safe for my child?
faqItems.answer: While not explicitly detailed, the clinic emphasizes early prevention to stop cavities. Dental sealants are generally considered safe and effective for protecting children's teeth from decay. Consult with Dr. Jennifer for personalized advice.

doctor.name: Dr. Jennifer Adelson
doctor.bio: Dr. Jennifer is a dedicated pediatric dentist and proud owner of Tiki Dental, with over 25 years of experience caring for children. Known for her compassionate approach, she ensures every visit is a fun and comfortable experience, helping kids develop healthy smiles while easing dental anxieties. In addition to comprehensive pediatric services, Dr. Jennifer offers myofunctional therapy, focusing on tongue posture and airway control to support optimal oral development and overall health. Her holistic approach ensures each child receives the highest standard of tailored care, shining through her passion for children.

reviews.name: Sarah P.
reviews.text: Dr. Jennifer and her team are wonderful! My daughter used to be so anxious about dentist visits, but they make it so fun and comforting. Bailey the therapy dog is a genius idea!

reviews.name: James K.
reviews.text: We've been coming to Tiki Dental for years, and they always provide excellent care. The staff is friendly, and Dr. Jennifer is truly the best pediatric dentist. Highly recommend their gentle cleanings!

reviews.name: Maria L.
reviews.text: My son needed a filling, and I was worried, but the team at Tiki Dental made it a breeze. They used kid-friendly methods and he felt totally at ease. Plus, they speak Spanish!

reviews.name: David R.
reviews.text: The focus on prevention here is fantastic. We appreciate the education on healthy habits and the fluoride treatments for our kids. They really care about long-term oral health.

reviews.name: Emily C.
reviews.text: The office is so welcoming and cheerful, perfect for kids. From scheduling to the actual visit, Ginna and the dental assistants make everything smooth and stress-free. A truly positive experience.

reviews.name: Jessica M.
reviews.text: Dr. Jennifer's holistic approach to oral health, including myofunctional therapy, is amazing. It's clear they look at the big picture for a child's development, not just their teeth.
